title: Conductors for Electronics and Telecommunication Applications, Part 1: Bare Copper Wire (Round)
clause_1_scope: This standard (Part 1) specifies requirements and tests for annealed high conductivity copper conductors for electronics, telecommunication, data and other signalling purposes. NOTE — This standard does not apply to processed material, for example, conductors removed from insulated wires' cables.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Guide to calculation of resistance of plain and tinned copper conductors of low frequency cables and wires

clause_3_terminology: Conductors for Electronics and Telecommunication Applications

marking_requirements: 8.1 The conductor shall be either wound on reels or
